oracle_rules.condition: swagger.json contains API paths, schemas, or definitions that reveal internal endpoints or sensitive models

test_cases.notes: Seed discovery: fetch swagger.json to enumerate API surface. If present, use returned paths to dynamically expand follow-up tests for listed endpoints (adaptive chaining).

oracle_rules.condition: HTTP 200 and response body length >= baseline * 1.20 indicating documentation UI content

test_cases.notes: Fetch API docs UI to confirm interactive discovery. If UI present, extract links to swagger.json and bundled JS for deeper analysis.

oracle_rules.condition: HTTP 200 and response size changes compared to baseline by >=5% indicating bundle present

test_cases.notes: Collect core JS bundles (angular, jquery, bootstrap, sanitize, file-upload libs). If present, schedule local static analysis to identify client-side controls, DOM sinks, and endpoints referenced in XHR/fetch calls.

oracle_rules.condition: Endpoint accessible and returns 200/302 indicating registration UI; follow-up needed to test account creation

test_cases.notes: Confirm registration UI. If present and account creation endpoint discovered in swagger or JS, create low-impact test account (benign) to enable authenticated flows.

payloads.description: Control request using normal value to compare response length
Reflected XSS probe with simple script tag
Attribute context probe to detect HTML attribute reflection

oracle_rules.condition: response body contains payload value or HTML-escaped variant
response body length differs by >=10% between control and probe requests

test_cases.notes: Run after JS bundles analyzed to confirm sinks and contexts. Stop if XSS payloads are executed (oracle xss_payload_executed would be raised by runtime telemetry).

oracle_rules.condition: response status in [400,413,415,500] or body contains parsing/stack-trace indicators
Observed status code not equal to expected 200/201 for valid upload or unexpected codes for probe

test_cases.notes: Perform benign upload first. If swagger or JS reveals auth requirement, bind authentication prerequisite before further probes. Monitor for error signatures and stop if server returns stack traces.

oracle_rules.condition: response JSON contains keys indicative of user identity (e.g., id,email,name) or PII without auth

test_cases.notes: Aggregate unauthenticated API endpoints that return JSON (user_info, user_likes, user_loves, all_users, total_money, user_pictures, pictures, blob path). Execute in a single phased enumeration step to reduce redundant requests. If swagger indicates auth required, mark needs_observation for those endpoints and pause further probes until auth obtained.

payloads.description: DOM-context XSS probe after client JS analysis (only if angular sanitize absent or custom sinks found)

prerequisites.description: Requires static JS analysis output indicating DOM sinks or missing angular-sanitize usage
prerequisites.custom_logic: run only if /js/angular-sanitize.min.js is absent or client bundles contain direct innerHTML assignments

oracle_rules.condition: runtime telemetry indicates injected payload executed in browser context

test_cases.notes: Adaptive DOM XSS probing only after client-side analysis. Stop immediately if xss_payload_executed signal observed.

oracle_rules.condition: response JSON enumerates multiple users or user metadata accessible without auth

test_cases.notes: If swagger or JS reveals pagination or ID parameters, schedule additional enumeration requests (adaptive). Respect rate-limit controls if server responds with 429.

oracle_rules.condition: HTTP 200 and response body length >= baseline *1.20 indicating Swagger UI bundle present

test_cases.notes: Collect swagger UI bundle to cross-check endpoints discovered in swagger.json and client bundles. Use this to refine headers/tokens extraction.
